interactions.name: rigid_endpoint_binding
interactions.action: Within the one host attempt test minimum, midpoint and maximum finite travel and return. Use actual hierarchy so front wheel assemblies follow opening shell. Inspect native visible surfaces and connection gaps at each endpoint.
interactions.expected: Measured joint endpoints and bound native root motion agree; axle connection remains attached. Report failures without shrinking ranges for tiny seam contacts.

interactions.name: continuous_roll_binding
interactions.action: One bounded-time spin per independent wheel, passing 2*pi with unwrapped joint targets. Use no joint range and no actuator angle clamp. Stop with bounded speed/torque commands.
interactions.expected: Visible wheel surfaces follow their axles through a full revolution; round symmetry alone is not motion proof, compare tracked mesh vertices.

interactions.name: tread_load_recovery
interactions.action: With wheel at neutral and hub held, load exposed bottom patch with a contact probe, hold, unload and recover. Bind visible native mesh to real flex positions; record displacement relative to rigid wheel transform.
interactions.expected: Attempt visible nonrigid displacement of at least 1 percent patch scale and measure recovery and strain. Failed dynamics/binding remains explicitly labelled; keep all rigid interactions.

review_requirements: Record one owner for every source triangle with unchanged rest surface, UV and PBR; show nonempty geometry for each planned moving part and active_tread_patch. Inspect selected handle/post and wheel/fork boundaries so region envelopes do not carry adjacent shell surfaces. Confirm patch faces are absent from rigid wheel ownership. Measure added axle area against each 0.004 cap and total 0.016 native-area cap; preserve all native faces.

Check shell_open at -pi/2,-pi/4,0; grip_slide at -0.16,-0.08,0 m; carry_fold at 0,pi/4,pi/2; and each steer joint at -pi/6,0,pi/6. Use actual bound visible surfaces and report attachment gaps at shell hinge fittings, both post guides, both carry mounts, carrier sockets and wheel axles. Confirm front wheels follow the opening shell and each wheel follows its own carrier. Preserve planned generous ranges; only approved limited-joint backoff with receipts may change them. These pose checks do not require another physics run.

Compile every roll joint with limited=false and no range or parameters.limits; do not impose actuator angle bounds. In the single host attempt command a bounded-time full revolution of each wheel with unwrapped targets and record achieved unwrapped travel separately from requested travel. Inspect visible tracked native vertices and attachment continuity at representative quarter-turn poses and after a full turn; rotational symmetry or joint numbers alone are insufficient. Verify the active patch and its pinned boundary follow wheel_front_left without a world-fixed tether.

Build a real coarse MuJoCo tetrahedral flex for active_tread_patch with nonzero free outer nodes and boundary/inner attachment to wheel_front_left, plus nonnegative skin weights reproducing the native rest patch. With the hub held at neutral, include contact load, hold, unload and recovery in the one host physics attempt. Report actual contact, wheel-relative visible nonrigid displacement normalized by declared patch scale, strain and recovery; target at least 0.01 relative displacement. A failed or insufficient response remains a failed attempt, never a compliance pass or rigid animation substitute.

Save the complete native-preserving GLB, MJCF, action plan and manifest early. Use only the single host dynamics attempt; report finite-state stability, achieved endpoints and actual contact measurements under physics_tolerances.py. Depth within 1% object diagonal needs no locality proof; any larger tolerance requires the existing helper's measured locality inputs. Retain usable interactions and native materials on failure. Delivery must separately label planned actions, simulated successes, parameter-preview-only actions, missing actions and deferred compliance, without claiming strict collision-free or full material acceptance.

interaction_coverage.label: Open and close shell
interaction_coverage.reason: Aligned seam fittings and paired broad shells support an estimated vertical hinge at negative x; 90-degree outward motion carries front shell and its wheel assemblies.

interaction_coverage.label: Retract and extend elevated grip
interaction_coverage.reason: Parallel posts enter rear-side top guides; one coordinated translation retains both posts and grip.

interaction_coverage.label: Roll all native wheel assemblies
interaction_coverage.reason: Circular wheel geometry at four native lower corners supports independent axles. Choose y-normal axle prior from frontal circles and side thickness, not oblique initial orientation. No angular stops or angle actuator bounds.

interaction_coverage.label: Steer wheel carriers
interaction_coverage.reason: Compact supports beneath each shell corner support approximate vertical swivel axes. Limited plus/minus 30 degrees is a preview convention, not a claim of actual mechanical stops.

interaction_coverage.label: Raise and fold carry handle
interaction_coverage.reason: Bridge ends support approximate mount-to-mount x hinge; construct and test 90 degrees despite partially obscured hardware.

interaction_coverage.label: Press and release one tread patch
interaction_coverage.reason: Dedicated flex-bound visible patch makes one bounded compliant attempt while retaining wheel rotation.

approximation_gaps.reason: Opening exposes unobserved internal shell surfaces and partition seams; preserve native outer appearance, omit interior reconstruction and cut caps. Only reviewed axle pins may add surface.

Use coarse shell wall boxes and wheel cylinders plus carrier capsules. Fine ribs, small fittings, insertion guides and actual cavity contacts are approximated; tolerant contact acceptance is not strict collision freedom.
One coarse tread contact patch attempts load and recovery; all remaining tread is rigid_follow, preserving material uncertainty without claiming full-wheel compliance.
